Bihar Electricity News : 125 yunit mupht bijli chhor dijie, CM Samrat ne kyon ki aisi apil ? | N18V
Bihar men 125 yunit mupht bijli ko lekar mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ki apil ke bad naee bahas chhir gaee hai. mukhyamantri ne sanpann aur inkam taiks dene vale logon se svechchha se mupht bijli ki sabsidi chhorne ki apil ki hai.
